rows.grounds: Compound of rāma, ekādaśa (eleven), pañca (five), iṣu (arrows), dhṛti (firmness), and arṇa (letter/syllable) in instrumental form; denotes specification by these elements/letters.
Compound of aṅga (limb/part) and kalpana (formation/conception); denotes the forming or assigning of limbs/parts.
